tex_content.label: sec:wave-solution-even-n
tex_content.html: For even $n$, extend $g,h$ to $\R ^{n+1}$ independently of the last coordinate and apply the odd-dimensional formula. Integrating over the two hemispheres gives, with $\gamma _n=2\cdot 4\cdots (n-2)n$, \[ (38)\qquad u(x,t)=\frac1{\gamma _n}\left[ \partial _t\left(\frac1t\partial _t\right)^{(n-2)/2} \left(t^n\fint _{B(x,t)} \frac{g(y)}{(t^2-|y-x|^2)^{1/2}}\, dy\right) +\left(\frac1t\partial _t\right)^{(n-2)/2} \left(t^n\fint _{B(x,t)} \frac{h(y)}{(t^2-|y-x|^2)^{1/2}}\, dy\right) \right]. \]
